value.answer: TSX is closed today for Thanksgiving, so no trading. Last close was Friday: the S&P/TSX Composite finished at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.48%), after a weak September jobs report eased rate hike worries. Trading resumes tomorrow, Oct 13, at 9:30 a.m. ET.
